audit.why: Jayce owns 1-5 on range and the chart only concedes 4-5 and first item as skill windows, with Yone taking over past two items. That fits 55.38% over 2071 games — Jayce's best matchup in this slice.
Spikes at 2-3 (Acceleration Gate), 6 (Fate Sealed, 120s at rank 1), first item (Eclipse) and late (Soul Unbound + re-engage) are correctly placed and each names its mechanic.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places call Fate Sealed a 'dash-through knockup all-in' and describe him dashing through you for a knockup. Fate Sealed does not knock up.
audit.why: Riot's description: 'Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.' It is a blink-behind and a pull, not a dash-through knockup. His only airborne is Mortal Steel at 2 stacks. Getting this wrong changes what you do: you cannot be knocked out of position, you get dragged back into his cleave range, which is why Thundering Blow has to go out immediately rather than after the CC ends.
audit.corrected: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last target in the line and pulls everyone toward him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound is described only as a snap-back escape, with no cooldown and no mention of the repeated damage.
audit.why: Riot's text: while unbound his spirit gains move speed, and when it ends he is forced back to his body and repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit. So the body is a fixed, telegraphed return point for an accelerated orb, and walking away from the spirit does not save you from the second helping. 22s at rank 1, 10s maxed.
audit.corrected: Aim at the body he must return to; the delayed second helping lands wherever you are.
